english.note: Use 型 for a person, look, or thing that is stylish or impressively cool, including when cool means exciting or awesome.
Use 型 when “clean” means cool or stylish, especially when praising someone's clothes or shoes.
Use this colloquial word when “cold” means stylish, impressive, or cool.

examples.english: Your outfit looks really cool today.
